paper.title_en: $g_{tt}g_{rr} =-1$ black hole thermodynamics in general quasi-topological gravity
paper.abstract_en: We present a unified framework for the discussion of black hole thermodynamics of $d$-dimensional static black holes with spherical or compact hyperbolic horizon topology satisfying $g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$ in Schwarzschild gauge. To that end, we consider any such black hole as a solution to an integrable $2$-dimensional effective dilaton theory and thereby as a vacuum solution to a generalised notion of $d$-dimensional quasi-topological gravity. We show that the generating function determining $f(r) = -g_{tt} $ in the integrated equation of motion provides the thermodynamic mass in a generalised first law with entropy computed as the Wald entropy. The framework presented here can be applied to singular and regular black holes with flat or anti-de Sitter asymptotics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出了一个统一框架，用可积二维有效膨胀子理论处理满足 g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1 的静态黑洞热力学，并将其视为广义准拓扑引力的真空解，核心关注广义第一定律、Wald 熵与生成函数，理论深度高，与黑洞热力学主题直接相关。
decision.title_zh: $g_{tt}g_{rr} =-1$ 黑洞热力学在广义准拓扑引力中
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个统一框架，用于讨论在 Schwarzschild 规范下满足 $g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$ 的 $d$ 维静态黑洞（具有球面或紧致双曲视界拓扑）的黑洞热力学。为此，我们将任何此类黑洞视为可积 $2$ 维有效膨胀子理论的解，从而视为 $d$ 维广义准拓扑引力概念的真空解。我们表明，在运动方程积分后决定 $f(r) = -g_{tt} $ 的生成函数，在广义第一定律中提供热力学质量，而熵按 Wald 熵计算。这里提出的框架可应用于具有平坦或反德西特渐近行为的奇异和规则黑洞。
